title: Teia Winter Events: Artz Friday
description: A walk through the Lounge with eight Teia winter events, one on each wall, shared by Malicious Sheep on Artz Friday with Tezos Commons.
intro: This Lounge is an experimental build in beta and may change frequently.

works.title: ZERO on Teia
works.about: A community creation event curated by an AI collector. Mint with #ZEROonTeia, Nov 1 to 30.

works.title: Teia Onboarder
works.about: An accessible onboarding event in Bangalore on Nov 28. Genesis open call Nov 12 to 28, with an exhibition in Decentraland.

works.title: Letters To The Machine
works.about: An open call for AI conversations, Nov 3 to Dec 6, with a presentation webinar in mid December. Its software and hardware archive will be open sourced. #LTTMTeia

works.title: Teia Africa: Sip and Paint
works.about: An IRL event on Dec 5, with an open call to be announced and a December exhibition. #TeiaAfrica

works.title: Circus Maximus
works.about: Physical and digital art. Open call minting Dec 1 to 8, then a Decentraland exhibition on Dec 12. #PostAmericana

works.title: The Wall Today
works.about: The wall is open through November and December, with an event feature in December. #XmassClash

works.title: 26POV
works.about: 26 artists, one letter each from A to Z. Open call Oct 27 to Nov 9, selected artists announced Nov 13, virtual exhibition Dec 15. #26POV

surfaces._about: A Tezos blue gradient on the walls and dome instead of the room's own pattern (Yoeshi, 2026-11-20: "we can do a tezos theme blue gradient backdrop instead of the sacred geometry for this one"); #0D61FF, the blue of the Tezos logo.

floor._about: Teia's rotating logos, the ones teia.art cycles through (teia-community/teia-ui, src/icons/svgs/rotating_logos, MIT), each by the artist its file is named for; made into white masks by skies/logos.cjs; drawn on the dance floor by gemfloor.js.

The Wall Today: its monthly results are minted under #TheWallToday, and its plaque names #XmassClash for December (Yoeshi, 2026-11-20: "it can be the tagged artworks on teia which are past months results from the wall, with the info about the upcoming event").
